triage_records.title: The Safety and Efficacy of Intermittent Fasting for Weight Loss

triage_records.title: Intermittent fasting and weight loss: Systematic review.
triage_records.relevance_rationale: The paper is a systematic review of 27 trials comparing intermittent fasting (IF) to calorie restriction. While it addresses the core comparison in the research question, it is a synthesis of existing literature rather than a primary empirical study. Furthermore, the abstract notes that most included studies were short-term (2-26 weeks), which limits its direct applicability to the 'long-term' aspect of the specific question, though it provides a summary of the current evidence base.

It is a review, not a direct empirical comparison.
